# CV

ATS-ready resumes, cover letters, and a public profile. Agents can use this product from their own AI chat — we are not integrated with ChatGPT or Claude.

## Connect

- Skill (copy into your AI chat): /skill.md
- REST catalog (OpenAPI 3.1): /openapi.json
- MCP (no auth): /mcp/cv
- MCP (account tools): /mcp/cv/auth  — Authorization: Bearer <agent-token>
- Discovery: /.well-known/mcp.json

## What you can do without an account

POST /api/v1/cvs — create a CV (or generate a PDF if template_id is set)
POST /api/v1/cvs/print — render a PDF, returns { url }
POST /api/v1/cvs/ats-check — rule-based ATS score (optional job_description)
GET  /api/v1/shares/templates — CV templates
GET  /api/v1/cover-letters/templates
POST /api/v1/cover-letters
POST /api/v1/cover-letters/print
GET  /api/v1/public-profiles/templates

Always send `X-Agent-Client: <platform>` (chatgpt, claude, copilot, gemini, minimax, grok, perplexity, cursor, other).

## Auth

POST /api/v1/auth/register or /login → Bearer token
Then POST /api/v1/agent-tokens to mint a dedicated agent token with abilities such as cv:read, cv:write, ats:check.

Envelope: { success, message, result }
